name: Cleansing the Scar stays a Priest quest that a Sun Cleric is not offered (#5756)
contract: Quest 9489 Cleansing the Scar (Ponaris 16276, Eversong Woods) has quest_template_addon AllowableClasses 16 (Priest only), and its credit comes from the Eversong Ranger 15938 smart_scripts spell-hit events for the eight Priest Power Word: Fortitude ranks. The report came from a Sun Cleric (class 27) on revision 526d04340, when every legacy quest class mask was widened to the custom classes of the same family, so Priest-only quests reached the Sun Cleric without its spell. ExpandLegacyQuestClassMask now keeps a single stock class quest closed to custom classes. Expected: a level 8 blood elf Priest can take 9489 and a level 8 blood elf Sun Cleric cannot.

steps.label: SETUP: the Priest can take Cleansing the Scar
The Sun Cleric cannot take Cleansing the Scar
